description: The file defines the ZoomActivity class, which demonstrates an image zoom animation by enlarging thumbnail images to full-screen view and allowing zoom-out on click. It handles UI interactions, animation setup, and coordinate calculations for the zoom effect.

classes.name: ZoomActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating image zoom animations from thumbnail to full-screen and back.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, attaches click listeners to thumbnail views, and retrieves animation duration.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the navigation 'up' action.

methods.name: zoomImageFromThumb
methods.description: Performs the zoom-in animation when a thumbnail is clicked and handles zoom-out when the expanded image is clicked.
